_meta.description: Worked example itineraries. These seed the 'Recommended Today' rail and give the itinerary builder something to show on first run.
_meta.note: User-created itineraries live in localStorage under `bali-explorer:itineraries` and use this exact shape. Every `spotId` must resolve against bali-spots.json — scripts/validate-spots.mjs enforces this.
_meta.travelTimeNote: `travelMinutesFromPrevious` is an editorial estimate including Bali traffic, NOT a Directions API result. The app recomputes real durations via the Directions API when a key is configured.

itineraries.title: One Day in Ubud
itineraries.summary: Temples at dawn, a waterfall before the heat, coffee and a ridge at dusk.

stops.note: First in, before the coach groups.
300 steps down while it is still cool.
Late for the light, but the walk is still worth it.
Lunch and coffee through the worst of the heat.
Shaded, so midday is survivable here.
Golden hour on the ridge to close the day.

itineraries.title: Weekend in the South
itineraries.summary: Cliff temples, hidden coves and two very different sunsets.

estimatedCost.note: Two days including a Jimbaran seafood dinner

stops.note: Day one. At opening the cove is nearly empty.
Time this to low tide or there is no beach.
Cliff path, then the kecak dance at sunset.
Day two. Stop at the cliff-road viewpoint on the way down.
Calm and shallow — the swimming beach of the two.
Agree the price per kilo before it hits the grill.

itineraries.title: Three Days: East, North & Nusa
itineraries.summary: A water palace, the island's best waterfall, then a boat to Penida.

estimatedCost.note: Includes driver, entries and the Nusa Penida crossing

stops.note: Day one. Before six or the gate queue eats the morning.
Buy fish food for the stepping stones.
Afternoon walk through the paddies, then stay the night.
Day two. The long drive north is the price of the best waterfall in Bali.
Bring a layer — it is properly cold at 1,200m.
Day three. Sanur ferry at 07:00, then straight across the island.
Walk the full rim; watch for mantas in the channel.
Swim, then make the last boat back. Do not miss it.
